CANCELLED FLIGHTS DUE TO #UWANPH 

Typhoon #UwanPH is expected to unleash intense to torrential rains, powerful winds, and wide spread coastal flooding nationwide, local air carriers Philippine Airlines (PR), Cebu Pacific (5J), and Cebgo (DG) cancelled some 25 domestic flights for Sunday, November 9, 2025 and 24 domestic flights for Monday November 10, 2025.

The routes affected are from Manila to Cauayan, Tuguegarao, Virac, Cebu, Masbate, Naga, Calbayog, Clark, and Catarman and its turn-around flights.

The cancellations were made to ensure passenger safety amid strong winds and heavy rains.

The airlines said that affected passengers may choose free rebooking within 30 days, travel fund conversion, or a full refund through their respective websites.

They also advised passengers not to proceed to the airport unless your flight are confirmed to operate. | via Rudy Santos

⛈️ NOT KPOP-RELATED ⛈️

As someone from Cebu City who experienced the severity of Typhoon Tino last November 04, I’d like to remind everyone to be careful especially that another typhoon is here, this time targeting the northern part of the Philippines. 

Preparedness will save your life. 

Aside from DOST-PAGASA’s website and public pages, here are some links that you can check for monitoring:
 
🔸 https://t.co/DMYNBLvPhH

This website lets you check your area’s hazard level (flood, landslide, storm surge). If your area’s level is high and local authorities advise you to evacuate, please do so. Many lives were lost in my area because they didn’t expect the heavy floods to come, but it did. Places that didn’t experience high floodwaters experienced it for the the first time, too. 

🔸https://t.co/k1zxVAVn9e

This is a wind map and weather forcast website. You can track the typhoon here. 

———————————————

I am not an expert, but these sites are worth looking into. It gives you a certain perspective as to where you are right now and might give you hints on what to do moving forward.  

Stay safe, everyone! ☔️

data.raw_text:
🌀 #TyphoonUwanPH / #Fungwong
📅 Issued: Saturday, November 8, 2025
🕕 9:00 AM Philippine Time

🌊 #TropicalStormUwanPH / #TropicalStormUwan / #TropicalStormFungwong has strengthened into #TyphoonUwanPH / #TyphoonUwan / #TyphoonFungwong, November 7, 2025, mow with winds of 150 kph.

🌀 #Uwan is moving west at 26 kph toward the Luzon region of the Philippines. The TYPHOON is traveling across some of the warmest ocean waters on Earth under low wind shear conditions, creating a near-perfect environment for rapid intensification 

Over the next 48 hours, UwanPH is forecast to intensify into a SUPER TYPHOON, potentially reaching winds of 230 km/h as TYPHOON #UwanPH approaches Luzon for a likely devastating LANDFALL on Sunday, November 9, 2025.

While the exact LANDFALL location remains uncertain, the most likely target area lies between Isabela Province (ECMWF) and the southern part of Aurora Province (GFS).

⚠️ All residents across Luzon should be actively preparing for powerful TYPHOON conditions late weekend. Identify a safe shelter, secure belongings, and plan to evacuate coastal and mountainous  regions before conditions dramatically deteriorate.

#SuperTyphoonUwanPH / #SuperTyphoonUwan / #SuperTyphoonFungwong impacts include:

🌧️ Torrential rainfall and intense tropical rain squalls, leading to massive inland and island flooding

🌊 A STORM SURGE up to 2 meters or higher, causing severe coastal inundation

💨 Extremely destructive winds of 215–235 km/h, with higher gusts possible

⚡ Widespread power outages, infrastructure destruction, and dangerous mudslides in elevated terrain

This will be a life-threatening and potentially catastrophic event.  Early preparation is essential for survival.

* Continue to monitor PAGASA’s official bulletins and follow the Hurricane/Typhoon/Cyclone Updates & Information page for continuous 24/7 coverage and updates.

Respectfully,

Roshin

Final preparations are underway in the small town of Dinadiawan, Philippines as Typhoon Fung-Wong (UwanPH) continues moving toward the region. @OreboundImages and I have secured a place along the coastline in this area. Storm surge could be a very big problem depending on where the eye tracks. Landslides and catastrophic flooding will cripple the road for multiple days. All visitors have been ordered to leave by end of day to reduce chance of casualties. This will be a very big problem for the Baler Bay Area. 

We are prepared and will provide more updates soon with @MyRadarWX
